summary: First full-stack test of MatShop.id. 25/25 backend pytest cases pass (public catalog, auth demo, listings CRUD + role perms, cart ownership/wholesale, full escrow flow: checkout -> pay -> ship -> release, asset auto-ship + download, seller stats). Frontend end-to-end flow via UI works: home/catalog tabs, listing detail with tier calculator (qty 55 switched to grosir price, savings shown Rp 840.000), add-to-cart, cart total, cart -> checkout -> payment -> orders (orders split per seller, status 'Dana Ditahan Escrow' for material, 'Dikirim/Diserahkan' auto-ship for asset-only order, Unduh/download button for assets, Konfirmasi&Rilis Dana button for buyer). Role switcher in user-menu-trigger shows role-switch-* options. Only issue found: direct deep-link to /checkout redirects to /keranjang due to CartContext race condition.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct navigation to /checkout always redirects to /keranjang because CartContext initializes with EMPTY and the guard `cart.items.length === 0` runs before async refresh completes. Normal flow via cart-checkout-button works, but deep linking / page refresh on /checkout breaks. Add a loading state (e.g., track `loaded` in CartContext) before applying the redirect.

action_items: Optional: fix /checkout race condition — gate redirect on CartContext 'loaded' flag so refresh / deep links don't bounce to /keranjang.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py put_object/get_object use blocking requests inside endpoints via run_in_threadpool (OK) but init_storage() inside put_object/get_object is also blocking requests; already wrapped. Good.
CheckOut race condition in /app/frontend/src/pages/Checkout.jsx:27 — redirect uses cart.items.length without a 'loaded' flag.
Backend /listings PUT validator calls validate_listing but does not check ownership until the mongo query; ownership mismatch surfaces as 404 which is acceptable but could be 403.

Role switch endpoint allows switching to any role and auto-adds it to enabled_roles — may be intentional (hybrid onboarding) but could let a buyer self-promote to supplier_vendor; verify this is desired business logic.
No tests folder existed before; conftest.py not needed as fixtures are inlined; keep backend_test.py as regression suite.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (19/20 UI assertions; the 1 fail is the deep-link race condition)

test_credentials: Demo login via POST /api/auth/demo with role=contractor_buyer|supplier_vendor|designer_creator; UI buttons data-testid=demo-login-* on /login
seed_data_creation: None added manually; backend seeds demo users and listings on startup via seed.py. Tests create TEST_* listings and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified end-to-end including wholesale tier pricing, escrow hold/ship/release, asset auto-ship & download, per-seller order split, role switcher. Only outstanding issue is minor Checkout.jsx cart-loaded race condition for deep-link navigation. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest) is reusable.
rca of the issue: Checkout.jsx line 27 reads `cart.items.length` from CartContext which initializes with EMPTY state. On deep-link / page refresh, the component mounts and the Navigate guard fires on first render BEFORE the async refresh() in useEffect resolves. Fix: expose a `loaded` boolean from CartContext and gate the redirect: `if (loaded && cart.items.length === 0) return <Navigate ... />`.
